content:
MAGA voices freaked out over the weather-related postponement of the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City on Thursday with baseless suggestions of a more sinister motive.

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced in a video shared on X late Wednesday that the iconic parade, which is celebrating its 100th edition this year, would be pushed back two days to Saturday.

The mayor said the decision was made “out of an abundance of caution,” with the city expected to experience “damaging wind gusts” on Thanksgiving.

The decision to reschedule the parade was made in coordination with Macy’s, the New York Police Department and other city agencies, according to a City Hall statement, amid a National Weather Service warning for high winds.

But some conservative critics of Mamdani weren’t buying the weather explanation, instead portraying the postponement as an attack on American traditions.

He didn’t cancel the Thanksgiving Day parade because of the rain, he cancelled the Thanksgiving Day parade because he hates America.

Reality television personality and unsuccessful Los Angeles mayoral candidate Spencer Pratt offered his own theory:

Gratitude is the ultimate virtue. It is utterly alien to the communist, because communism operates entirely on envy and covetous rage. This is why they are so obsessed with canceling Thanksgiving. They found the playbook with Covid…just call it off for “safety reasons”.

Pratt also shared a Fox News post about the postponement alongside a video lasting more than five minutes in which he branded Mamdani a “vile commie mayor” and railed against what he portrayed as the erasure of American history.

“I warned you...the communist always attacks your history. They will always justify it, they will couch it in soft language, but bit by bit, they will erode your traditions. Brick by brick, they will disassemble your home, and remake it in their vision,” he captioned the clip.

Conservative pundit Stephen L. Miller, meanwhile, cast doubt on Mamdani’s stated rationale for rescheduling the event, writing: “This isn’t why he’s making the change.”

Far-right activist and close Trump ally Laura Loomer posted: “Muslim mayor destroys 100 years of tradition.”
